segments.text:
V. 38.
And all the people came early in the morning to hear him— How much happier were his Diſciples in theſe early Lectures, than the Slumbers of the Morning could have made them on their Beds! Let us not ſcruple to deny ourſelves the Indulgence of unneceſſary Sleep, that we may Morning after Morning place ourſelves at his Feet, receiving the Inſtructions of his Word and ſeeking thoſe of his Spirit.
